name: Sample streamlines based on labels assignments
summary: Keeps the streamlines of a tractogram whose label is 1 in a binary labels file (e.g. from SIFT) and removes the rest, using MRtrix3 connectome2tck.
description: Uses MRtrix3 connectome2tck with the per-streamline labels as node assignments to extract the streamlines labelled 1 into a new tractogram. Use it to apply a streamline selection, such as the SIFT surviving-streamline labels, to the original tractogram. The labels file must have one entry per streamline of the input tractogram.

inputs.description: Per-streamline labels (one value per streamline); streamlines labelled 1 are kept.

outputs.description: Tractogram containing only the streamlines labelled 1.

parameters.description: Intended to binarise the labels (any value > 0 becomes 1) with binarize_labels.py before filtering. Note: main on this branch never runs binarize_labels.py, so the setting has no effect.

failure_modes.fix: Check that the labels file has one entry per streamline of the tractogram.
